sqlReaderQuery.value: SELECT @{pipeline().parameters.AcademicYear} as AcademicYear, @{pipeline().parameters.CollectionPeriod} AS Period

SELECT 
	(SELECT Count(1) FROM Payments2.EarningEvent                          WHERE AcademicYear='@{item().AcademicYear}' AND CollectionPeriod='@{item().Period}') AS EarningEventCount,
	(SELECT Count(1) FROM Payments2.EarningEventPeriod                    WHERE AcademicYear='@{item().AcademicYear}' AND CollectionPeriod='@{item().Period}') AS EarningEventPeriodCount,
	(SELECT Count(1) FROM Payments2.EarningEventPriceEpisode              WHERE AcademicYear='@{item().AcademicYear}' AND CollectionPeriod='@{item().Period}') AS EarningEventPriceEpisodeCount,
	(SELECT Count(1) FROM Payments2.DataLockEvent                         WHERE AcademicYear='@{item().AcademicYear}' AND CollectionPeriod='@{item().Period}') AS DataLockEventCount,
	(SELECT Count(1) FROM Payments2.DataLockEventNonPayablePeriod         WHERE AcademicYear='@{item().AcademicYear}' AND CollectionPeriod='@{item().Period}') AS DataLockEventNonPayablePeriodCount,
	(SELECT Count(1) FROM Payments2.DataLockEventNonPayablePeriodFailures WHERE AcademicYear='@{item().AcademicYear}' AND CollectionPeriod='@{item().Period}') AS DataLockEventNonPayablePeriodFailuresCount,
	(SELECT Count(1) FROM Payments2.DataLockEventPayablePeriod            WHERE AcademicYear='@{item().AcademicYear}' AND CollectionPeriod='@{item().Period}') AS DataLockEventPayablePeriodCount,
	(SELECT Count(1) FROM Payments2.DataLockEventPriceEpisode             WHERE AcademicYear='@{item().AcademicYear}' AND CollectionPeriod='@{item().Period}') AS DataLockEventPriceEpisodeCount,
	(SELECT Count(1) FROM Payments2.FundingSourceEvent                    WHERE AcademicYear='@{item().AcademicYear}' AND CollectionPeriod='@{item().Period}') AS FundingSourceEventCount,
	(SELECT Count(1) FROM Payments2.RequiredPaymentEvent                  WHERE AcademicYear='@{item().AcademicYear}' AND CollectionPeriod='@{item().Period}') AS RequiredPaymentEventCount,
	(SELECT Count(1) FROM Payments2.Payment                               WHERE AcademicYear='@{item().AcademicYear}' AND CollectionPeriod='@{item().Period}') AS PaymentCount,
	(SELECT Count(1) FROM Payments2.Job                                   WHERE AcademicYear='@{item().AcademicYear}' AND CollectionPeriod='@{item().Period}') AS JobCount,
	(SELECT Count(1) FROM Payments2.ProviderAdjustmentPayments            WHERE CollectionPeriodName=CONCAT('@{item().AcademicYear}','-R',RIGHT('00'+'@{item().Period}',2))) AS ProviderAdjustmentPaymentsCount
